Otacon effective simple/secondary/special now command buffs. His terminal never emits an offensive ray. PhilanthropyUpload remains an authored project support name.
Raiden effective NinjaRunSlash and ZandatsuOverdrive are single-target physical blade contact. The shown mechanical core prop does not implement stolen HP, instant-kill or dismemberment.

limitations: No official source-game animation frames are reproduced or verified1:1.
Beowulf solo spring/backflip/body-press keyframes are an authored summary, not the entire three moonsault opponent-interaction sequence.
Raiden keeps a non-graphic mechanical fuel-cell prop, omitting organic anatomy and full Zandatsu game mechanics.
Otacon lab-coat design is the local scientist reference; project PhilanthropyUpload support is not claimed to be an identical MGS1 power.
Skullgirls official/wiki accesses were blocked403. Steam responses did not provide usable character details and are not cited as costume evidence.
Stature compensation is renderer-only and body-ROI based. Actual kneeling support, wrestling crouches and native rotations remain shorter than standing.
